use_case: Computer-vision crop yield prediction: weekly block-level yield estimates 1 to 3 weeks ahead from drone imagery, for company farms and 18 contract growers' fields; used for harvest crew planning, H-2A job order planning, and retail volume commitments
vendor_or_model: Agronomy analytics vendor (SaaS computer-vision model, fine-tuned per customer)
source_evidence: EV-047 (agronomy analytics subscription); EV-065 (AI tool discovery); EV-048 (click-through terms)
data_categories: Drone RGB and multispectral imagery; block boundaries; variety and planting dates; historical block yields from tally totals (no per-worker data); incidental images of people
affects_individuals: Yes (indirectly: hours offered to up to 370 H-2A workers and crews; growers' expected volumes; incidental images of people)
consequential_decision_category: Employment (substantial factor in H-2A job order and crew-hour planning today); escalates further if used to cut hours without review
human_in_the_loop: Today: Farm Managers glance at estimates before planning. Required: hand-count calibration before any crew or sales decision; no job order or crew-hour change from the model alone; decision log
applicable_laws: 20 CFR 655.122(i) three-fourths guarantee and 655.122(j)(1) hours-offered records (indirect); 14 CFR Part 107 (imagery flights); FTC Act Section 5 (vendor claims); Fla. Stat. 501.171 not triggered while imagery is not linked to names
status: In production since 2025-11 (strawberries, tomatoes, watermelons); approved with conditions due 2026-12-31

use_case: FMIS irrigation scheduling with automatic application: an evapotranspiration and soil-moisture model in SYS-01 sets run times, and since 2026-04 sends schedules automatically to 12 of 46 Farm 3 pivots through the pivot manufacturer's cloud; recommendation mode elsewhere
business_owner: Director of Irrigation and Water Resources
vendor_or_model: FMIS vendor (model inside SYS-01); pivot manufacturer cloud executes schedules
source_evidence: EV-065 (AI tool discovery); EV-009 (12 Farm 3 pivots scheduled automatically); EV-007 (SYS-01 settings)
data_categories: Soil moisture probes; weather stations; crop stage; flow history; pivot status
affects_individuals: No (crop and water impacts; worker safety only through equipment operation)
consequential_decision_category: Safety/CI (automatic control of irrigation equipment and groundwater withdrawals)
human_in_the_loop: Today: none for the 12 automatic pivots (daily review after the fact). Required: plausibility limits in SYS-01, daily approval by the Farm 3 irrigation lead until conditions are met, automatic fallback to the last approved schedule on sensor faults; never controls fertigation injection
applicable_laws: Water use permit conditions (withdrawal limits and monthly reports); FIFRA and WPS not triggered (no chemigation through AI-002); supplier terms under POL-01 4.9
status: In production on 12 Farm 3 pivots; automatic application limited to approved hours with daily approval from 2026-10-01; conditions due 2026-11-30

use_case: Camera-based targeted spraying: machine-vision on 6 sprayers detects weeds and turns individual nozzles on and off during herbicide passes
vendor_or_model: Sprayer manufacturer's embedded vision model, updated through the equipment dealer
source_evidence: EV-065 (AI tool discovery); EV-010 (6 sprayers with targeted spraying)
data_categories: Camera images of crop rows (processed on the machine, not stored); as-applied maps to SYS-08 and SYS-01
consequential_decision_category: None directly; escalates to Safety/CI if the system could exceed the label rate or apply outside the target area
human_in_the_loop: Operator sets the product and rate within the label; the system can only reduce coverage; weekly scout check of targeted passes; operator can switch to broadcast at any time
applicable_laws: FIFRA: no use inconsistent with labeling (7 U.S.C. 136j(a)(2)(G)); WPS application and hazard information, including the treated area (40 CFR 170.311(b)(1)(iii)); dealer data terms
status: In production on 6 sprayers since 2025-03; conditions due 2027-03-31

use_case: Packinghouse optical grading: computer-vision graders on 2 packing lines sort tomatoes and peppers by color, size, and defects; grade output feeds pack-out reports and grower pool settlements
vendor_or_model: Optical grader manufacturer's vision models (on-premises, vendor-updated)
source_evidence: EV-065 (AI tool discovery); EV-047 (grader manufacturer); EV-054 (grades feed settlements)
data_categories: Fruit images and grade results by lot and grower; no personal data
affects_individuals: Yes (indirectly: settlement payments to about 30 contract growers, several of them individuals)
consequential_decision_category: None in the repository rubric's categories (commercial accounting to growers); re-tier to High if grades were used to set credit terms for growers
human_in_the_loop: Today: none before settlement. Required: weekly hand-grade audit sample per grower; reconciliation of grader output to packed cases; Controller review before release; grower dispute process
applicable_laws: PACA growers' agent accounting (7 CFR 46.32(b)); grower marketing agreements; FTC Act Section 5 (vendor claims)

use_case: Generative AI assistant for office work (drafting, summaries, translation of notices into Spanish): public chatbots used by staff without review until 2026-09, replaced by an enterprise assistant with no-training terms
vendor_or_model: Enterprise generative AI assistant (large language model; SaaS under no-training and deletion terms)
data_categories: Prompts and documents from office users; Restricted data prohibited (POL-04 4.5); Confidential data allowed in the enterprise tool only
affects_individuals: Potentially (if Restricted data were entered, or if drafted notices reach workers or growers)
human_in_the_loop: Users review every output before use; worker and grower notices and translations reviewed by HR or Grower Services and counsel before sending
applicable_laws: Fla. Stat. 501.171(2) (reasonable measures if personal information were entered); NIST AI 600-1 used as guidance
status: Approved; enterprise assistant rollout from 2026-10-01; consumer chatbot sites blocked on company devices
